// A victim: it seeds a subcollection whose name appears only mid-path.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');

const seedItem = (uid, itemId) => db.doc(`users/${uid}/backpack/${itemId}`).set({ qty: 1 });

test('an item survives', async () => {
  await seedItem('42', 'hat');
});
